name: Access blocked by false no-internet errors
description: Users are shown a "no internet connection" message or are kept out of their account despite having working connectivity in other apps.

name: Login failures and repeated logouts
description: Users get logged out or cannot sign in, often seeing connection or number-verification errors even though their network works.

name: Password rejected at sign-in
description: A user reports the app will not accept their password.

name: Paid users still blocked or overcharged
description: Users feel they are paying too much or are still locked out of music after paying for premium.

name: Basic features moved behind paywall
description: Users complain that core listening features now require premium, which they see as a degraded free experience.

name: Free tier limits and forced trials
description: Free users face skip caps, locked song selection and order controls, and are pushed into premium trials.

name: Premium cost seen as excessive
description: A user says the subscription cost is far too high for what they receive, with playlists also lost.

name: Premium signup and cancellation problems
description: Users cannot purchase an individual premium plan, or lose playback immediately after subscribing, and find ads excessive on the free tier.

name: Missing songs and unwanted picks
description: Users say favourite or Bollywood tracks are absent and that the app's song choices and playlist additions are off-target.

name: Lyrics fail to load or appear
description: Users report lyrics not loading or showing inconsistently across songs and devices.

name: Songs unavailable or removed
description: A user says some underrated songs they want are not available in the catalog.

name: Podcast playback lagging on premium
description: A premium user reports certain podcasts lagging, and another says they switched apps to access a specific podcast.

name: Unwanted recommendations and repetitive DJ
description: Users are bothered by recommended songs appearing in their playlists even when turned off and by the DJ repeating the same tracks.

name: Background downloads stall
description: Downloads get stuck in the background and only resume when the app is opened.

name: Downloaded content vanishes
description: Users lose previously downloaded music, especially when offline, and storage moves have wiped downloads.

name: Miscellaneous download and wrap issues
description: Brief comments touch on music playing after the phone is off and an inability to open a yearly Wrap.

name: Vague negative feedback on recent update
description: Short reviews express dissatisfaction with the app and a recent update, with no specific problem named.

name: Excessive data and storage use
description: A user reports the app consumes too much data and phone storage.

name: Wi-Fi, device and offline connectivity faults
description: Playback stops or fails on Wi-Fi, after phone changes, or in offline mode, and casting to other devices is difficult.

name: App crashes or will not open
description: Users say the app crashes or fails to open, particularly after a recent update.

name: Black screens, spinning and playback failures
description: Users encounter black screens, endless spinning, failure to play playlists or casts, and inappropriate random tracks.

name: Stuck loading and lyrics not loading
description: The app freezes on its logo screen, and lyrics for playlist songs fail to load.

name: Playback stops randomly mid-song
description: Music or shows halt unexpectedly and do not resume where they left off, even after reinstalling or clearing data.

name: Unresolved token error at sign-in
description: A user receives a "no token provided" message they cannot fix and is considering cancelling.

name: Frequent unskippable ads
description: Users find ads too frequent, too long, and unskippable, interrupting playlist use.

name: Navigation and wrong-song playback
description: Users find the app hard to navigate, with clicks playing unexpected songs or demos, and report ads and uninstall intent.

name: Playlist order and library navigation broken
description: Users cannot reach chosen songs in a playlist, Google Assistant fails to play playlists, and the new home screen hides previously found playlists.

name: Forced shuffle and missing playback controls
description: Users lose the ability to skip, rewind, repeat, queue, or play in order, with shuffle now forced.

name: Recent redesign removed key features
description: Users say the latest update removed familiar player features and Canvas, and pushes premium upsells at every turn.
